notes.title: Patch 0.41 - New Gallery!
notes.content: [p][b]Hey hey[/b], hi everyone! Today it's time for a cool little patch that will add and fix a lot of things you've been asking for.[/p][p][/p][p]This update reintroduces the [b]gallery[/b], with the option to view all NSFW scenes from the game (you must unlock them and have seen them in the game before, of course). There is also a new category that allows you to see collaborations with other artists! For now, you can see everything, but in the future we will introduce a system to unlock these illustrations by finding them in bottles that have washed up on the beach in the game. So enjoy it now.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633738/ed44f926db1d852d907fc5a6211a8b9033db6d67.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We also added a new NSFW scene with Marcia, various bug fixes, etc... Sooo, see you in October for the next chapter in the story![/p][p][/p][h3]Content[/h3][list][*][p]New [b]gallery[/b] in the main menu with artists collab illustrations and all NSFW events.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NSFW Event Marcia 02[/b][/p][/*][*][p]New scene with [b]Amar[/b] during Chapter 2 to introduce the character, at the end of Steve's shop segment. [i](The character appeared randomly on the game, but since few players saw her, we removed this feature and will give the character more space in the rest of the story.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]New interface[/b] in cutscene sequences with illustrations (including NSFW events), with a smaller dialogue box that moves so as not to obstruct the visibility of the illustration.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New main menu[/b], with a [b]3D diorama background[/b]. Some easter egg gonna be added latter...[/p][/*][*][p]For peek routine NSFW scenes, you can now [b]choose whether or not to view the sequence[/b]. This prevents NSFW content that may not be of interest to certain players from being viewed without their consent nor sexual/genre preferences.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Misc[/h3][list][*][p]New map menu design in the smartphone.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a sequence with the final illustration of the frame at the end of Chapter 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Polish and sounds added for the NSFW Event Louis 01.[/p][/*][*][p]Chapter 02 Quest graph adjustments.[/p][/*][*][p]New sounds added for various quests.[/p][/*][*][p]Ticket prices for starter characters (Dolores/Dimitri/Finn) changed from 50 to 30, and Dolce from 80 to 60.[/p][/*][*][p]New various icons for items in the inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Night lights in the grocery shop.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bugs[/h3][list][*][p]NPC's dialog bubbles will not appear during events.[/p][/*][*][p]Frame items correctly removed from inventory after Chapter 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Final frame correctly added to the inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where NPCs had their positions incorrectly indicated with the ping if you slept at the lighthouse.[/p][/*][*][p]The zoom of the map and medium quest tracker is now centered relative to the screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various pathfinding bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Texture bug in Finn Event 01.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where you couldn't sleep in the lighthouse between midnight and 6 a.m. (quite ironic...)[/p][/*][*][p]Bug in Chapter 2 where you couldn't enter buildings after the Dolce event.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Known issues[/h3][p][/p][p]I frequently receive messages telling me that the game has backup issues after updates. The game has a lot of systems that interact with each other, which can quickly break certain variables when you update the game. In addition, Patreon and Steam builds are saved in the same place, and this will change when we add Steam Cloud support.[/p][p][/p][p]Please remember that the game is in early access and that these are unfortunately common issues. We are improving the save system as we go along, and when the game is released in 1.0, there will be no more issues like this because the entire game infrastructure will be robust enough.[/p][p][/p][p]If you encounter any issues that are not listed in the patch notes, try [b]starting a new game[/b]. I know it's annoying, but for now there are no other solutions, especially for people using Patreon builds, which are subject to many more bugs.[/p][p][/p][p]Until then, [b]thank you for your support and understanding. See you soon![/b][/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.40 - One Ticket Please!
notes.content: [p][b]Helloooo everyone![/b] We are proud to present the new 8th Heaven update![/p][p][/p][p]This is our third and [b]biggest update[/b]. We're proud of the work we've done and can't wait for you to play![/p][p][/p][h2]Devlog[/h2][p][/p][p]Originally, we were only supposed to release the Chapter 1 around March/April. But many things have changed, both in the story and in the gameplay. But many things have changed, both in the story and in the gameplay. We made some decisions and everything became clearer when we found a solution to all our problems: [b]the ticket system[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]A lot of players said it was weird to have NSFW scenes with npc from the start without any introduction. So we created a new mechanic, a new character, we tried to link it all logically to the game's lore, and it unlocked a lot of things in the progression. So we have the [b]first two complete chapters[/b] to offer you in this update instead of only one! Added to this are a few new details that you can read about in the patch note.[/p][p][/p][p]Concerning the future of the game, we're going to release a brand-new [b]roadmap[/b] for late 2025 and early 2026! The next update will be released on [b]Halloween[/b] and will probably be just as big as this one. We'll be releasing [b]Chapter 3[/b], which will be the [b]conclusion of the game's first story arc[/b]. The entire introduction to the game will be [b]reworked[/b], and you'll have access to the [b]interior of the Lighthouse[/b], with a [b]small bedroom to restore and upgrade[/b]...[/p][p][/p][p]But before all that, we'll be [b]releasing a patch in a few weeks[/b] in order to add a couple of things we didn't have time to finish for version 0.40, due to health issues from our programmer. There will be a [b]new NSFW scene[/b], some polish, and more.[/p][p][/p][p]Anyway, here's the long-awaited patch note![/p][p][/p][h2]Patch 0.40[/h2][p][/p][p]The main content of this update is the continuation of the story. The first two chapters of the game. Before this, only half of the first chapter was available.[/p][p][/p][h3]Content[/h3][list][*][p][b]Chapter 1 - [/b]4 new steps.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chapter 2 - [/b]11 new steps.[/p][/*][*][p]New character - [b]Louis[/b], the ticket seller.[/p][/*][*][p]New character - [b]Amar[/b], a mysterious girl.[/p][/*][*][p]New location - [b]Louis' trailer[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]New location - [b]Grocery shop[/b] (wip).[/p][/*][*][p]New shop - [b]Love Machine[/b]. Buy npc tickets![/p][/*][*][p]New feature - [b]Battle Tickets[/b]. You need to buy tickets to unlock battles. Every fightable npc has his own ticket to buy.[/p][/*][*][p]New feature - [b]Sleeping[/b]. You can skip a day, but only after the morning.[/p][/*][*][p]New feature - [b]Workbench[/b] (wip).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Louis NSFW event #01[/b] - My sweet secretary ~[/p][/*][*][p]Two new Steam achievements.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Misc[/h3][list][*][p]Dialogue UI rework.[/p][/*][*][p]Various UI improvements (effects, shiny stars, new fonts, etc...)[/p][/*][*][p]Steve's Shop improvements (new entrance, camera and lod fix).[/p][/*][*][p]New foliage shader (trees dithering and high resolution stability).[/p][/*][*][p]Level design improvements accordingly (new trees and foliage).[/p][/*][*][p]New small area in the Village.[/p][/*][*][p]Electric poles in the Village.[/p][/*][*][p]Navmesh cleaning.[/p][/*][*][p]New interior ground and wall shader.[/p][/*][*][p]New trailer texture for Louis.[/p][/*][*][p]New Dolores expressions.[/p][/*][*][p]Quest tasks in dialogs are now highlighted in red.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Bugs[/h3][list][*][p]Trigger issue with elevator during game intro.[/p][/*][*][p]Various UI optimization.[/p][/*][*][p]Probably lot of stuff I didn't take note of lol.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Known issues[/h3][p][/p][p]Many of the game's systems have been changed/updated. You may encounter a few bugs, which will probably be fixed in the patch to be released in the coming weeks.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Normally, saves are compatible, but if you have any problems with progress, you will probably have to start a new game.[/i][/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.30 - Dramaaatic Events!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b] This is the 2nd major update for 8th Heaven. G R E A T.

[h2]Devlog[/h2]

The game is progressing well! However, we got a bit mixed up in the various announcements. There are so many things to work on that we're trying to work on a bit of everything at once, and that takes time for our micro-team of three goofballs dev. For this update, I've decided to focus on polishing a number of elements and continuing to incorporate feedback from the community. That's why we've reworked the code and improved the Bartending mini-game, added new tutorials, etc...

But we still have content for you! You'll see that in the patch note.

For the next, we're still working on the continuation of chapter 1. We'll be releasing a veeery huge update this summer. It's going to take some time, but it should double the current playing time, as well as adding characters and new mechanics. So don't miss out! Our biggest problem right now is the interiors. It's a pain to do and requires a lot of graphic resources. But we'll be adding plenty of interiors to bring more life to the game. Like... the lighthouse, the shop, and more. We already focused on this in the last patch note, but we've come up with some good ideas to make the battle system interesting and, above all, useful for progression.

Anyway... life goes on. Here's the patch note.

[h2]Patch 0.30[/h2]

The main content of this update is new events for all npc. These are slightly more “narrative” and serious events that progress the character arcs. It's also the beginning of dating...

[h3]Content[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Dolores Event #02[/b] - Dolores defies Dimitri... One challenge too many.
[*][b]Dimitri Event #02[/b] - You have to make your own decisions...
[*][b]Finn Event #02[/b] - A very tiring day... The light at the end of the tunnel?
[*][b]Dolce Event #02[/b] - Deliveries that go wrong...
[*][b]Marcia NSFW Event #02[/b] - You have such nice... tattoos!
[*][b]Barista mini-game rework[/b] - New tutorial, animated character, bug fixes extra price bonus and new sounds!
[/list]

[h3]Misc[/h3]
[list]
[*]Rework of the job menu + [b]tutorial reset[/b] button.
[*]Add [b]4K support[/b]. Widescreen still little buggued so... play in windowed. Use ALT + ENTER is you want to switch between.
[*]Various new dialogue sprites and expressions.
[*][b]Coconut-Shy mini-game balance[/b] - +1 ball when 15 points, new tutorial, various new hints.
[*]Level design adjustments on Creekpark.
[*]Various new UI sounds.
[/list]

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*]Finn Event #01 adjustments and various bugs.
[*]Finn Main Quest 100$ bug fixed (for real this time...)
[*]Widescreen cursor bug.
[*]Gloryhole tutorial save bug.
[/list]

[h3]Known issues[/h3]

Gallery menu removal. There's lotta bugs and we've currently reworking this menu and adding all the NSFW content in it. It's currently unavailable.

notes.title: Patch 0.21
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Here's a little patch which completes last month's additions.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9mSyjJ1.gif[/img]

We've added a long-awaited (lol) feature: you can now see where are the npc in your zone!!! Yes, you can finally stop running around like an idiot. It only took us a YEAR to get this out. Sorry. Soooooorry.

Here's the patch note:

[h2]Patch 0.21[/h2]

[h3]Content[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]NPC indicator[/b] when ping with [b]right mouse click[/b]. The indicator show only npc's in the [b]same zone as you[/b]. It show if the npc is inside a building too. When you open the map in the smartphone, a [b]small house icon[/b] also indicates whether the npc is in a building too.

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*]Auto-resolution detection at start.
[*]Fullscreen mode is now fullscreen-windowed.
[*]The game don't run in background anymore. A temporary solution until we make a real pause system.

[*]Fix with Dimitri height with overworld sprite.

[*]Add scrollwheel icon in the Gloryhole minigame.
[*]Elevator bug fix.
[*]Steve's shop carpet!!!
[/list]

xoxoxoxox happy holidays byyyye

notes.title: Patch 0.20 - Gloryhole & Routines
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b] We're proud to show y'all the game's first major update!

[h2]Devlog[/h2]

We're making good progress on the game's story. Since this patch has mainly added [b]NSFW[/b] and [b]sandbox[/b] content, we'll be focusing on the story for the next update. The next update should bring new indoor zones, the continuation of Chapter 1 and several new events for npcs.

We'll also be adding new characters, and introducing new battles with those new npcs! The game's battle system will be used more and more throughout the story, as will “love points”, which currently have no use. Since sales are good too, we're also going to start investing in “real” music for the game (half of it are royalty free stuff). We can't wait to show you!

So far, the roadmap has been respected, we're pretty happy about that, and we're even adding more things than planned. If all goes well, the next big update should be available around February at least. In the meantime, you can always support us on Patreon with monthly build stuff... We'll also have to deal with the dialogue system to integrate localization, but we'll wait until the end of the Chapter 1 for that.

Anywaaaaay, here's the patch note for the update!

[h2]Patch 0.20[/h2]

In this update, we've added a new mini-game, the [b]Gloryhole[/b]! We'll let you discover it in-game. We also rework all the routines for each NPC. Each one has a secret scene during their routine and it's up to you to find it...

[h3]Content[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Gloryhole[/b] minigame!
[*][b]Monday routines[/b] - NPCs have now consistent routines and each routine will tell a lil' story ([i]only Monday is available for now[/i])
[*][b]New routine system[/b] - NPCs can wander around on some POI and share dialogues with others.
[*][b]Steam achievements[/b] - Discover 3 new achievements. More to come...
[*]4 new routine [b]animated NSFW[/b] scenes!
[*]Added [b]shortcuts[/b] and various level design changes (Lighthouse to Village, Creekpark rework, etc...).
[*][b]4 new items[/b] - Each NPC has its favorite one. Randomly spawn in the world.
[*][b]Medium events[/b] - The more you progress in the story, the more narrative events you'll have with her. Currently only two with introduction.
[*][b]Medium Smartphone App[/b] - Following an medium event, you can have access to the quest tracker on your smartphone.
[/list]

[h3]Misc[/h3]

[list]
[*]Days are 1.7 times longer. Hooray!
[*]New mood dialogues when talking to an NPC.
[*]Auto-save when quitting the game.
[*]Updated coconut shy quest (tincan item saved and stuff).
[*]Non-dateable NPCs are listed in the glossary, but without events and relationships.
[*]Battle system balancing (Soda 02 less hard).
[/list]

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*]That f*ckin' battle shield bug is corrected, after two years. Sheesh.
[*]Barista Score bug for the main quest is corrected.
[*]Clamp cursor.
[*]Intro bug with a layer which detected bethomet_animation when mouse raycast blah blah it's corrected anyway.
[*]NPCs no longer leave after a battle is engaged.
[*]Various dialogue posing errors.
[*]Random NPCs generation bug when night falls corrected.
[*]Ambient sounds now fade instead of stopping abruptly.
[/list]

[h3]Known issues[/h3]

This is our "most" stable build yet, so if you find any bugs, you can report them on the steam hub, thanks! If you have issues with achievements activation, let us now too. We've tried to resolve most of the feedback we've received from the community.

notes.title: Patch 0.12
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b] Small QOL patch for this month!

[h2]Devlog[/h2]

We went back to work at the beginning of September after a few weeks' vacation. The game is progressing well and the next update should arrive at the end of October. It will contain everything on the roadmap, and more! We will also add the first "giveable" items. You'll be able to find different items all over the place, and earn them in some of the mini-games.

Each NPC has its own preferences, so you can take the opportunity to make some gifts to build up your relationship more quickly! You can follow the game's twitter/X account for more info and screens on development too, we post from time to time. But not too much, we have to work too ːKnightsHonkersː

Gloryhole is finished too, and now we're back to work on the various new NSFW scenes. Since demand was quite high... We'll be adding quite a bit of NSFW content in the next update.

For translations into (especially) Asian languages, we're working on it. But it's going to take some time, so we'll talk about it in a later devlog.

Anyway, here's the patch note for the update!

[h2]Patch 0.12[/h2]

[h3]Content[/h3]
[list]
[*]New icon in the UI indicating the [b]day/night[/b] status.
[*]The [b]same icon[/b] is now visible in the [b]glossary[/b] to indicate a character's event time!
[*]New [b]mouse and keyboard[/b] movement system (yeaaah)
[*]The Medium can [b]talk[/b] now!
[/list]

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*]The game has been ported to a new version of Unity (2021.3 LTS).
[*]Miscellaneous UI optimization.
[*]Water shader has been reworked.
[*]Water and waterfall VFX have been reworked.
[*]Correction of various pathfinding problems.
[*]The posing of all dialogues has been revised and various small cutscene errors have been corrected.
[*]Rewamp of the animation blending system, no more weird bugs with overworld characters animations (like Bethomet in the void moonwalking...).
[*]Reduced size of npc collision box to prevent player from jamming them.
[/list]

[h3]Known issues[/h3]

We've rewritten a lot of the systems for this patch (especially UI stuff), in anticipation of even more strong foundations for the development. There may be a few bugs we haven't seen, which will be corrected in the next patch. As usual, if you see something, you can post a message on the game's steam forums, thanks!!!

notes.title: Patch 0.11, Roadmap & Launch Summary
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b] It's time to take a look back at this release week.

[h2]Release[/h2]

First of all, [b]thanks to everyone[/b] who bought the game and support the development. We've been working on the world building for years and development officially began in [b]2022[/b]. Currently we're [b]three[/b] people working on the game, and that's a lot of work.

The launch went rather well, for an early access! We read all the messages and reviews and we have taken note of [b]all your comments[/b]. Concerning the current state of the game, we're aware that the content is very light. Let's be transparent with you about this! Overall, the game works well (technicaly speeking, for a complete simulation game with time cycle and npc IA) and the foundations are very solid. Adding content is pretty fast. In fact, we've added a new soda topic with new dialogues in the patch. We know which road we are taking, and it's going to be a straight one! We've created a [b]roadmap[/b] so you can get an idea of what's to come.

Once again, thanks to everyone who played the game. We're going to redouble our efforts to bring you a game that lives up to our ambitions and your expectations. The 3rd job/mini-game, the [b]Glory Hole[/b], is currently in development and will be available in the [b]next major update in autumn[/b].

[h2]Roadmap[/h2]

Here's the roadmap for the end of the year. Given that feedback is mainly asking for sandbox content, we're going to focus first on adding interactive elements to the world.

We'll also be putting in the final Monday routines for the characters. Everyone will have a [b]little NSFW scene[/b], so you'll have to follow the characters closely.

For the second update, we'll be focusing on achieving the end of Chapter 1, and find out what happens to Steve...

[i](And yes we're going to rework the horrible player moving system and add keyboard controls, I promise.)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633738/da4445103b3184f48e2e7aea793f8d94794db715.png[/img]

[h2]Patch 0.11[/h2]

You may have had a surprise when you woke up this morning: we've made a small update to the game. We've added a few things and fixed most of the bugs you pointed out to us. Here's the list of the improvements:

[h3]Content[/h3]
[list]
[*]New Topic Soda: [b]Exhibitionism[/b]. Discover 4 new dialogues for this 4-star soda!
[/list]
[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug when you to lose $300 when giving an item to Dolores.
[*]New line of dialogue to indicate that you need to speak to the secretary in the intro.
[*]Adjustment of Coconut Shy rewards.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused some npcs to stop walking after a ping.
[*]Fixed a bug in the inventory, which sometimes required two clicks to open.
[*]The Topic Sodas weren't saved.
[*]Inventory items no longer appear in the log when the game is launched.
[*]Fixed a bug where Dimitri, Dolores and Steve didn't reappear after the last cutscene.
[*]Edit of the tutorial after the intro to include information on how the medium feedback works.
[*]Fixed a bug that enabled Steve's glossary entry after talking to Dolores.
[/list]
